description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering search parameters related to internationalization languages in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and provides properties and methods to specify filtering options such as whether to include only enabled languages or only newly added languages. It also initializes default sorting by language name.

classes.name: I18NLanguageSearchFilterParams
classes.description: DTO class for specifying search filters for language-related data, enabling filtering by 'enabled only' and 'added only' status, with default sorting by language name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field set to language name.

methods.name: getEnabledOnly
methods.description: Returns whether the filter is set to include only enabled languages.

methods.name: setEnabledOnly
methods.description: Sets the filter to include only enabled languages.

methods.name: getAddedOnly
methods.description: Returns whether the filter is set to include only added languages.

methods.name: setAddedOnly
methods.description: Sets the filter to include only added languages.
